profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over a decade of experience architecting scalable backend systems, driving real-time data integrations, and leading full-stack engineering teams. Adept at navigating complex technical challenges across mission-critical domains, from high-throughput advertising infrastructure to real-time trading systems. Currently expanding systems programming expertise through graduate studies, with a focus on performance, concurrency, and distributed architectures. Equally comfortable as a hands-on engineer or leading teams to build resilient, high-impact solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and built a real-time commodity trading integration via websockets, enabling low-latency access to commodity futures prices and hedging functionality for Indigo’s grain marketplace.

positions.title: Tech Lead Manager
positions.description: Tech-lead manager for a team of 3-6 engineers building a grain marketplace for growers and regional buyers. Mentored junior engineers through regular code reviews and technical design sessions. Coordinated requirements and priorities across product, business and other engineering teams.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Primarily server side development work using a wide range of technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on both client and server side of the assets management system of a new library information system.  Helped develop the 2nd version of their iOS mobile app.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked independently on a new version of ModelGolf's primary golf teaching software
- C++, C#, with DirectShow, Direct3D, and GDI+

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- Worked independently and with a team on a new version of ModelGolf's primary golf teaching software
- C++, C#, with DirectShow, Direct3D, and GDI+
- Developed a ModelGolf screen saver integrating core aspects of the teaching software.
- Acted as a team leader, organizing and coordinating the efforts of the group
